description: This file defines a mock class ControlServiceMock for the IControlService interface, used for unit testing within the Rialto server service component. It includes mock methods for control management, application state setting, and ping functionality.

classes.name: ControlServiceMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IControlService interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: addControl
methods.description: Mocks adding a control with a control ID and client reference.

methods.name: removeControl
methods.description: Mocks removing a control by control ID.

methods.name: ack
methods.description: Mocks acknowledgment of a control with control ID and message ID.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Mocks a ping operation with an ID and acknowledgment sender.
